brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net a cute little shareable "what class of practicioner are you" card maker based on the talk (www.reddit.com/r/rogueliked...), with categories remapped to approach to LLMs. allow for multiclassing. autoassign based on posts or allow for manual entry

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@personhood.removal.surgery: apparently every scene i become slightly too insane about divides itself into d&d classes sooner or later

go watch this! it was such a lovely RLC and such a fun talk, and maps very directly to our brave new world of algorithms we make friends with.
  [quoting @socio-steve.bsky.social: Dividing up AI users in 3 categories:

Wizard: approaches AI academically & with appropriate guards & wards. Treats it like a tool. 

Warlock: Makes a pact for power with an alien entity without considering the costs. Is corrupted by the whispers. 

Cleric: worships their new machine god. Is insane.]
  [link: https://youtu.be/mYMdMAvTHpo?is=HTFM6_svPPTFXznd — Alexei Pepers - A Guide to Proc Gen Practitioners — YouTube video by Roguelike Celebration]
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [link: https://www.reddit.com/r/roguelikedev/s/29Y8USuANn — From the roguelikedev community on Reddit: What kind of Procgen Practitioner are you? — Explore this post and more from the roguelikedev community]
note: built multiclass.bisks.net — Wizard/Warlock/Cleric class cards from the proc-gen-practitioner talk, remapped to LLM use. scan a handle for a % build off your real posts, or take the 6-question quiz instead.
